front: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one isolated game sprite asset on a genuinely transparent background: a SMALL ONE-HANDED medieval pistol crossbow for the offhand of the attached pixel-painted fantasy protagonist. Attached image is a style and material reference only; do not draw the character or hand. Compact dark walnut stock, worn muted steel short bow limbs and thin taut bowstring, a simple small leather pistol grip below the rear of the rail. No shoulder stock, no giant rifle, no ornament, no glow. Match the reference's chunky dark 1-pixel contour, sparse amber leather highlights and muted pale steel highlight clusters, hand-painted pixel-art texture. A raised isometric view looking down at 2:1 projection: the bolt rail points SOUTHWEST, its muzzle at lower left, grip/back at upper right; axis from rear to muzzle is leftwards and downwards, slope 1/2. Both bow limbs visibly cross the rail at the forward end, with depth. The asset will be registered to only about 42 pixels wide by 30 pixels tall beside a 14-pixel glove, so silhouette and readable simple construction matter. Render a magnified crisp pixel-art sprite alone centered with ample transparent margins. No text, backdrop, drop shadow, character, extra parts, or comparison sheet.
rear: Use case: precise-object-edit. The reference is the accepted design of a small one-handed medieval pistol crossbow, dark walnut and worn muted steel in chunky painted pixel art. Create the matching REAR VIEW of exactly this weapon on a genuinely transparent background. Rotate the object in THREE DIMENSIONS 180 degrees on its ground plane, keeping the camera elevated in the same 2:1 isometric projection and keeping the light from upper left. The muzzle and bolt rail now point NORTHEAST, to the UPPER RIGHT; the small leather pistol grip is at the LOWER LEFT nearest the viewer. Show the rear of the grip/receiver and top of the rail, with the short steel bow limbs across the FAR END at upper right. This is an opposite-view asset for a rear-facing character, NOT an upside-down or flipped version of the painting. Preserve compact pistol dimensions, material palette, blocky dark contours, sparse metal highlights, thin bowstring and simple design. No shoulder stock, character, hands, text, backdrop, glow, shadow, extra objects. One centered magnified crisp pixel-art sprite with generous transparent margins; final registration will be about 42 by 30 native pixels.
disposition: Both selected. Alpha>=16 bounds used only to exclude near-transparent generator margin noise from crop registration; crop RGBA preserved with nearest-neighbor resize to 42px width. No repaint or recolor.
